header: An email written in Mail:
text:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks for getting back to me so quickly. I looked over the draft contract this morning and most of it is fine, but I have two small concerns before we sign. The payment schedule says thirty days from invoice, and our finance team usually works on forty-five, so could we either change that or add a line about late fees only applying after forty-five days? The second point is the renewal clause. It renews automatically for another year unless one of us gives notice, and I would prefer that we review the work together before anything renews.

If both of those are easy changes, I can sign by the end of the week. Let me know if you would rather talk it through on a call.

Best regards,
Anna

header: An email written in Mail:
text:
Hey Mum,

Just wanted to let you know we landed safely and the hotel is lovely. The room looks out over the harbour and we can hear the boats in the morning, which is a lot more relaxing than it sounds. Tomorrow we are planning to take the ferry to the island and walk around the old town, and on Saturday there is a market that the woman at the front desk says we should not miss.

The weather has been warm but not too hot, and I have been good about the sunscreen, I promise. I will send some photos when we have better wifi. Give the dog a hug from me and tell Dad the train tickets worked perfectly.

Love you,
Sophie

header: A paragraph written in a document:
text: Most people think of habits as something you either have or do not have, but in practice they behave more like paths through a field. The first time you walk across, the grass springs back and there is no trace of where you went. After a few weeks of walking the same way, a faint line appears, and after a few months it is the easiest way to get from one side to the other. The difficulty with changing a habit is not that the old path is strong, but that the new one has not been walked enough times yet to be the obvious choice.

header: A product review written in a browser:
text: I have been using this backpack every day for about three months now, mostly for cycling to work. It is comfortable even when it is full, and the laptop pocket keeps everything separate from my lunch and gym clothes. The waterproof cover is the best part, because it has kept my things dry through some very heavy rain. My only complaint is that the side pockets are a little too small for a large water bottle, so I usually end up carrying it inside instead.
